# Phase 0 — Design Lock

**Date:** 2026-03-26  
**Status:** Locked for implementation

## Core Decisions

| Decision | Choice | Rationale |
|----------|--------|-----------|
| Reverse Proxy | Nginx (existing) | Already deployed, stable |
| Identity Core | Authentik server + worker + PostgreSQL | No Redis needed in current releases |
| First Protected App | Trilium Notes | Low blast radius, recoverable |
| Auth Method Priority | OIDC/OAuth2 first, proxy provider second | Cleaner modern path |
| Version Tag | `ghcr.io/goauthentik/server:2024.12.3` | Pinned, not floating |
| Outpost Strategy | Embedded initially | Simpler deployment, separate later if needed |

## FQDNs and Ports

| Service | Internal | External | Port |
|---------|----------|----------|------|
| Authentik Server | `authentik-server` | `auth.titan.local` | 9000 (HTTP), 9443 (HTTPS) |
| Authentik Worker | `authentik-worker` | N/A | Internal |
| PostgreSQL | `authentik-postgres` | N/A | 5432 |
| Trilium (first app) | `trilium` | `notes.titan.local` | 8080 |

## External Access Path

```
Cloudflare/Tailscale → Nginx (TLS termination) → Authentik → Protected Apps
```

## Data Paths

| Path | Purpose | Volume |
|------|---------|--------|
| `/var/lib/authentik/data` | Authentik core data | `authentik-data` |
| `/var/lib/authentik/media` | User uploads, icons | `authentik-media` |
| `/var/lib/authentik/certs` | Custom certificates | `authentik-certs` |
| `/var/lib/postgresql/data` | Database | `authentik-db` |
| `/var/lib/authentik/templates` | Custom templates | `authentik-templates` |

## Resource Allocation

| Component | CPU | RAM |
|-----------|-----|-----|
| Authentik Server | 1 core | 1 GB |
| Authentik Worker | 0.5 core | 512 MB |
| PostgreSQL | 0.5 core | 512 MB |
| **Total Reserved** | 2 cores | 2 GB |

## Secret Management

| Secret | Storage | Rotation Policy |
|--------|---------|-----------------|
| `AUTHENTIK_SECRET_KEY` | Docker secrets / `.env` | On compromise only |
| `POSTGRES_PASSWORD` | Docker secrets / `.env` | On compromise only |
| `POSTGRES_USER` | Docker secrets / `.env` | Static |

## Network Strategy

- **Phase 1-2:** Internal Docker network only
- **Phase 3+:** Expose via Nginx with proper TLS
- **Outpost Network:** Same Docker network (embedded outpost)

## Version Pin

```yaml
# Locked version - DO NOT USE :latest
AUTHENTIK_IMAGE: ghcr.io/goauthentik/server:2024.12.3
POSTGRES_IMAGE: docker.io/library/postgres:16-alpine
```

## Required Nginx Headers

```nginx
proxy_set_header Host $host;
proxy_set_header X-Forwarded-Proto $scheme;
proxy_set_header X-Forwarded-For $proxy_add_x_forwarded_for;
proxy_set_header X-Real-IP $remote_addr;

# WebSocket support (REQUIRED for Authentik)
proxy_http_version 1.1;
proxy_set_header Upgrade $http_upgrade;
proxy_set_header Connection "upgrade";
```

## Rollback Strategy

1. **Database backup** before any upgrade
2. **No downgrade support** - must restore from backup
3. **Outpost versions** must match server version

## Acceptance Gates

### Phase 1 (Core Deploy)
- [ ] Server container healthy
- [ ] Worker container healthy  
- [ ] PostgreSQL reachable
- [ ] Admin login works locally
- [ ] `/health/ready` returns 200

### Phase 2 (Proxy + TLS)
- [ ] Authentik UI loads through Nginx over TLS
- [ ] No redirect loops
- [ ] WebSocket connections work
- [ ] Client IPs visible in Authentik logs

### Phase 3 (Identity Baseline)
- [ ] Admin group created
- [ ] User group created
- [ ] Break-glass admin account ready
- [ ] MFA enforced for admins
- [ ] Email delivery tested

### Phase 4 (First App)
- [ ] Trilium protected by Authentik
- [ ] Unauthenticated → redirect to Authentik
- [ ] Authenticated → lands in Trilium
- [ ] Group-based authorization works
